label: judge: product
result:
I wrote `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/product.md` (about 91 KB) and did not commit, as the task said. The seven section files already cover most of what the three designers proposed, so this file adds what no section owns. Its scorecard has 44 rows for the product as a whole. Every PARITY or BELOW row names the fix. The one row left BELOW is Reading & Writing practice, and that is by decision 3; G11 covers what can be done without an R&W bank. It also has 17 new resolutions, R39–R55, to append to §2.2. They settle the places where the section files disagree: three different ways to start the day, `D` both choosing D and opening Details in the practice runner, `warmup` meaning two different things, two versions of the cause chips, and Plan citing a table and "optional chips" that Practice rejected. Then 14 upgrades, G1–G14, each build-ready with its own acceptance checks. The most important is G3, twins that keep the trap, because I measured the current code: a fresh seed drops the student's trap 44.1% of the time, a 60-seed walk finds it 98.4% of the time, and `progress.record` closes a mistake after any right answer on its question type, whether or not the trap came up. The others:

- **Start and first visit:** one "Start today" run through the whole Due list, with plan tasks ticked by whatever did the work (G1), and an 8-question start with question 1 answered on Today (G10).
- **One vocabulary:** six labels for four ideas, one key per verb, `Z` for undo, and a grep check for retired phrases (G2).
- **Every question looks the same:** one action row on every surface that shows the answer, including the moment a mistake is fixed (G4).
- **Type pages:** a public page for each of the 386 question types at `/types/?t=` (G7).
- **Points and numbers:** one points chip, with practice and single-test points shown differently (G5); every number opens its working, and a check proves the same number reads the same on every endpoint (G6).
- **Access:** figure descriptions, table headers, MathML and Read aloud (G8); I found 76 figure templates, none with an accessible name.
- **Speed:** measured budgets with a check before merge (G9).
- **Conveniences:** empty states that show a sample row and a small action with its time, and handing the open page to a phone (G12).
- **Full SAT later:** one `subject` contract so R&W can be added without rework (G11).
- **Before the test:** one printable test-day sheet (G13).
- **The bank:** one audited pass through the question bank, one topic per commit (G14).

The file also has 35 quoted changes to `spec/rebuild-v2.md` (lines 1–648 and 10970–11183) and 17 to the sibling upgrade files; I checked every quote against its file. It ends with 25 rejections, one line each with the reason. Offline packs, paper versions for classes, a practice-based score and a second points model are rejected for consistency with the section files.
